## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION — conflicting signals: Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Leadership concentrated (Top 5 span Industrials, Healthcare, Materials) while Technology is underperforming, so strong breadth but mixed internals.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Industrials lead: FDX (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +22.02%) ABOVE TREND, UPS (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND.  
Healthcare strong: AMGN (1W: +12.41% | 1M: +12.49%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +12.61% | 1M: +9.29%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +10.57% | 1M: +12.27%) ABOVE TREND.  
Energy showing strength: XOM (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +25.79%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +10.91%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +16.53%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: ORCL (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -25.74%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -17.03%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -23.78%) BELOW TREND.  
Consumer Discretionary weak: AMZN (1W: -12.11% | 1M: -12.93%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -10.89% | 1M: -18.15%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -4.48% | 1M: -4.71%) BELOW TREND.  
Real Estate modestly behind at the margin: sector 1W: +0.86% | 1M: +4.97% (sector-level internal rotation).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: DOW (1W: +15.35% | 1M: +28.15%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%) ABOVE TREND, MMM (1W: +12.73% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +12.61% | 1M: +9.29%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +12.41% | 1M: +12.49%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 span Industrials, Healthcare, Materials). Style: Value/Cyclical.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: CRM (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -28.10%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -23.78%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -11.05% | 1M: -31.72%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -25.74%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -11.95% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: DOW (1W: +15.35% | 1M: +28.15%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%) ABOVE TREND, MMM (1W: +12.73% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND; MAJOR DIVERGENCE present (GOOGL, META, JPM, V, MA, LLY show 1W vs 1M mismatches) — treat as tactical signals, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology mixed and under pressure; ORCL (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -25.74%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -17.03%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -2.99% | 1M: -1.96%) BELOW TREND — sector down 1W and 1M, watch for further dispersion.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials showing selective strength and rotation into payments/large banks: JPM (1W: +5.40% | 1M: -1.40%) RECOVERY, V (1W: +3.03% | 1M: -6.83%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -5.23%) RECOVERY; beware idiosyncratic losers like PYPL (1W: -23.29% | 1M: -30.92%) BELOW TREND.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare constructive and defensive: JNJ (1W: +5.61% | 1M: +15.66%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +2.95% | 1M: +9.48%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +12.41% | 1M: +12.49%) ABOVE TREND — sector acting as a reliable bid.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclicals and defensive healthcare cyclicals: position exposure toward CAT (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +22.02%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +25.79%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +5.61% | 1M: +15.66%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to large-cap Technology names showing sustained weakness such as MSFT (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -17.03%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -25.74%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: CAT (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +22.02%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +25.79%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +15.35% | 1M: +28.15%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: AMZN (1W: -12.11% | 1M: -12.93%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -25.74%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -23.78%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +6.64% | 1M: +12.90%) — breadth leadership. Energy (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +15.85%) — earnings/dividend momentum.  
BEARISH: Technology (1W: -4.39% | 1M: -6.62%) — check for continued dispersion. Consumer Discretionary (1W: -0.11% | 1M: +1.41%) — watch earnings/news sensitivity.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: -2.99% | 1M: -1.96%) BELOW TREND — watch reclaim of 1M range for trend repair or failure below recent swing lows for continued risk-off in semi space.  
AAPL (1W: +7.18% | 1M: +6.83%) ABOVE TREND — monitor follow-through above last-week highs for continued leadership.  
JPM (1W: +5.40% | 1M: -1.40%) RECOVERY — track consolidation above this week's range as confirmation of bank-led rotation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
CAT (+50): AI/data-center strength headline; CAT (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +22.02%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.  
VLO (+55): Q4 beat/dividend increase; VLO (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +10.91%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.  
AMGN (+50): Target lift after strong Q4; AMGN (1W: +12.41% | 1M: +12.49%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
AMZN (-50): AI spending and cautious profit outlook; AMZN (1W: -12.11% | 1M: -12.93%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.  
MRK (-50): Subdued 2026 outlook headline; MRK (1W: +10.57% | 1M: +12.27%) ABOVE TREND — news diverging from price, monitor for distribution.  
TSLA (-45): Weak 2025 read/strategic pivot headlines; TSLA (1W: -4.48% | 1M: -4.71%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, Value/Cyclical style favored given cyclicals and healthcare leadership.  
CAT (ABOVE TREND), XOM (ABOVE TREND) and DOW (ABOVE TREND) are showing relative strength.  
Key risk: major divergence across mega-cap Tech (several 1W vs 1M mismatches) and mixed news on MRK/AMZN — monitor for trend confirmation.
